scripts.sync-data: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); for (const f of ['certifications.json', 'profile.json']) { const src = path.resolve('..', f); const dest = path.resolve('data', f); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Synced ' + f + ' from root'); } }"
